newsitem.title: USA: Mallinckrodt in deal with Medi-Physics.
newsitem.headline: Mallinckrodt in deal with Medi-Physics.

text.p: Mallinckrodt Inc said Monday it reached a five-year agreement to distribute the heart imaging agent Myoview, which is produced by Medi-Physics Inc.

Under the deal, both Mallinckrodt and Medi-Physics will provide the product in the United States, Mallinckrodt said. Medi-Physics, a unit of Amersham International Plc, is the developer and manufacturer of Myoview.
"With a market potential of nearly $150 million, this is a significant and important agreement for both companies," said C. Guy Marlow, president of Medi-Physics, Amersham Healthcare.
Myoview is a technetium-based agent for imaging that provides physicians with a quick, clear view of restricted blood supply to the heart muscle, as in angina or heart attacks.
